_readme: Ecology card parameters (audit M14, Phase 2). Reported apart from damage.

mangroveMigrationM.label: How far mangroves can move inland
mangroveMigrationM.note: A mangrove cell counts as squeezed when no free land in the future tidal frame lies within this distance. Placeholder: set at a few grid cells; the real distance depends on the slope behind the stand and how fast the sea rises over the horizon. Schuerch et al. (2018) frame survival by the landward accommodation space; this is the tool's simple stand-in for it.

builtBlockShare.label: Built share that blocks migration
builtBlockShare.note: Land with at least this share under roofs and roads (OSM + Microsoft footprints, OSM roads) is not available to mangroves, nor is any CRZ-II urban cell; seawalls, dunes and khazan bunds block by holding the future high tide back. Placeholder threshold.
